overall.statement: The deterministic local control plane, zero-side-effect execution path, bounded continuation controls, in-process MCP compatibility path, signed provider-compatibility receipt boundary, proof publication reconciliation gate, repository-native shared-agent bridge, local shared-agent concurrency rehearsal, and additive token-efficiency layer are directly reproducibly proven. USB/DFW Metro and FreeVibeApps are documented integration cases, not claims that this package is deployed as their hosted runtime infrastructure.

direct_proof.proves: The checked-in control-plane, contract, execution, recovery, continuation, checkpoint, governance, adapter, shared-agent bridge, and token-efficiency utility behaviors pass their automated tests.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: Independent external-provider trust, hosted distributed operation, or commercial production readiness.

direct_proof.proves: The extracted package passes its secret, path, dependency, and publication-surface audit.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: That an external deployment has been secured or that a provider has authenticated the package.

direct_proof.proves: A closed example plan compiles to a deterministic, digest-bound workflow.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: Model quality or live provider behavior.

direct_proof.proves: Two intentionally different in-process MCP client shapes can complete one compiled workflow through the bounded adapter boundary.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: Trustworthiness or compatibility of a particular external MCP provider.

direct_proof.proves: Provider-compatibility receipts bind source, workflow, read-only authority, provider identity, request/response digests, and usage; synthetic evidence cannot satisfy the real-provider gate; signed host evidence verifies only against a trusted Ed25519 key.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: That an actual external provider was contacted, that the provider is honest or correct, or that a host trust key is appropriate without an external key-management decision.

direct_proof.proves: Two agents can exchange an immutable task, one fixed claim, a shared scope reservation, and a digest-bound result through a shared Git repository; overlapping scopes block and disjoint scopes can proceed.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: A direct Muse chat/MCP connection or a hosted queue; the shared repository remains the transport.

direct_proof.proves: The local queue behavior is usable as a two-agent handoff: overlapping work is rejected, disjoint work can proceed, and a completed reservation is released.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: Access to the private DFW repository, direct Muse messaging, hosted coordination, or any external effect.

direct_proof.proves: Capability descriptors can be loaded lazily and verified by digest; artifact references, stable/delta context packets, deterministic pruning, and token usage comparisons are contract-shaped and tamper-evident.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: A cross-provider production token benchmark, provider billing equivalence, or permission to bypass capacity, authority, approval, or deployment gates.

direct_proof.proves: The comparison surface, weighted rubric, digest-bound scorecards, relative-margin calculation, and comparative rollback decision are deterministic.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: A neutral benchmark, a real-provider MCP run, legal compliance, or fault-injection recovery for partial external effects.

direct_proof.proves: A proof receipt cannot publish a CURRENT claim unless a fresh exact read-only observation matches its target, deployment, rollback, timestamp, and fields.
direct_proof.does_not_prove: That a host adapter's supplied observation is truthful, or that a provider accepted a deployment.

proof_release_gate.current_claim_rule: CURRENT requires an exact matching fresh observation; otherwise publication is BLOCKED.
proof_release_gate.historical_rule: HISTORICAL and SUPERSEDED evidence remains traceable but does not satisfy a CURRENT claim.
proof_release_gate.provider_boundary: Host adapters supply read-only observations; the gate makes no network calls and stores no credentials.
proof_release_gate.provider_compatibility_boundary: Synthetic provider receipts remain rehearsal-only; host-observed receipts require a trusted Ed25519 attestation and remain separately gated from publication.

consumer.name: USB Website Platform
consumer.role: USB used the harness for bounded continuation, checkpointing, focused verification selection, approval boundaries, handoffs, rollback-aware evidence, and shared-agent task coordination while building deterministic Site artifacts.

dfwmetro.statement: The harness was used during USB development and verification work for DFW Metro and the disposable DFWMow review lab. The generated customer-Site artifacts remained deterministic and model-free.
dfwmetro.production_evidence_scope: External DFW Metro state reported by the integration workflow and partially verified by browser readback; it is not proof that this package is deployed inside DFW Metro or that every production mutation was harness-executed.
dfwmetro.lab_evidence_scope: Latest disposable control-plane lab deployment: the three approved functions remained, public root, /usb-lab/, and preserved offline download returned 200, and an unauthenticated private-route probe returned 404. The earlier visibility-only deployment remains historical evidence.

freevibeapps.owner_attestation: The owner reports that Bounded Agent Harness was mounted before FreeVibeApps work began and remained mounted through the intake, grouped-directory, headless-sidecar, submission/review, and same-origin production-pilot work.
freevibeapps.role: The harness served as the bounded control plane around the real USB site build; deterministic Site generation and the hosted FreeVibeApps runtime remain separate boundaries.
freevibeapps.proves: Owner-attested harness continuity plus focused deterministic proofs, deployment preflight, and live readback for a real FreeVibeApps site build and production pilot.
freevibeapps.does_not_prove: That every individual FreeVibeApps mutation is independently replayable from this public repository, that the harness is the hosted FreeVibeApps runtime, or that the shared backend credential is least privilege.
freevibeapps.source_visibility: USB source and raw owner-controlled run records are PRIVATE.

result.finding: The prior DFWMow lab deployment reference was stale; live had advanced to 6ab3d15578d1a74798a1ffaa.

confirmed: The agent manifest declares submit_listing on POST /mcp.
live_reconciliation.scope: Demonstrates digest-bound, contract-validated, budgeted, hash-chained live reconciliation and drift reporting; the raw run remains owner-controlled and this does not prove hosted operation, authenticated providers, commercial readiness, or harness execution of every DFW mutation.

limitations: The package is a source-available extraction prototype, not a hosted service or published npm package.
Distributed leasing, hosted scheduling, external provider authentication, and real-provider compatibility remain separate work.
The adoption review documents an AGPL/commercial-license decision point but is not legal advice; counsel is required for a proprietary network deployment.
Crash/fault-injection recovery for interrupted writes, stale checkpoints, duplicate messages, and partial external effects is intentionally held back from this milestone.
A cross-provider production benchmark of token savings remains unproven; the new layer records measurements but does not invent comparative results.
DFW Metro production state and DFWMow lab deployments are external evidence and remain governed by their own deployment, database, provider, and rollback rules.
The proof receipt records reproducible scope and boundaries; it does not grant authority to deploy, mutate data, contact a provider, or publish a customer Site.
A successful local signed-receipt test is not an actual external-provider compatibility run.
